entities.summary: Giovanni Tornabuoni was a performers & entertainers in Florence (1428-12-31, Florence – 1497-04-26), a notable figure of the Medieval era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
